description.en: The application ID for interactive messages.

description.zh:
系统消息扩散类型，取值：

- 0：不扩散。

- 1：扩散到指定人。

- 2：扩散到群组。
description.en:
The system message diffusion type. Valid values:

- 0: No diffusion.
- 1: Diffusion to specified users.
- 2: Diffusion to the group.

description.zh: 操作人用户UserId。该用户必须是群组的创建者。
description.en: The user ID of the operator. This user must be the creator of the group.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~343507~~)。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limits

The QPS limit for this API is 100 queries per second (QPS) per user. If you exceed this limit, API calls will be throttled, which may affect your business. You can make API calls at a reasonable rate. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~343507~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live mute-all-group-user --app-id VKL3000 --group-id AE35-0000-T95F --operator-user-id de100a0 --broad-cast-type 2 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live MuteAllGroupUser --region cn-hangzhou --AppId VKL3000 --BroadCastType 2 --OperatorUserId de100a0 --GroupId 'AE35-0000-T95F'
